title: At 50, I’m A Child of Grace
lineage: Published interview with film journalist Steve Ayorinde discussing his book on Nigerian cinema. His evidence for the shooting date is unstated in the interview.

passages.locator: Answer beginning That’s the popular narrative in a section of the film industry
passages.quote: was shot in 1991 and marketed by Keneth Nnebue’s NEK Videos before Living in Bondage.
passages.note: Ayorinde identifies Ishola Ogunsola's Aje Ni Iya Mi as the film. His shooting date differs from Haynes's 1989, and the interview names Nnebue's company as its marketer.
